user.title: Add a Brother label printer
user.description: Configure a QL-710W or PT-E550W reachable over Wi-Fi or Ethernet on raw TCP (usually port 9100).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the printer. Check its address, port, and network connection.

abort.unsupported_device: This Brother printer model is not supported.

invalid_print_input.message: Provide exactly one of text, image_path, or blocks.

invalid_image_path.message: Could not read the image under /config/www: {error}

invalid_asset_path.message: Could not read the image or font file under /config/www: {error}

print_label.name: Print label
print_label.description: Print text, an image, or a composed sequence of content blocks on a configured Brother QL or P-touch printer.

image_path.name: Image path
image_path.description: Image path relative to /config/www, for example labels/logo.png.

blocks.name: Composed content
blocks.description: Ordered text, image, and spacing blocks. Text blocks can have their own alignment, size, weight, and font. Asset paths are relative to /config/www.

alignment.name: Text alignment
alignment.description: Align text labels to the left, center, or right. Ignored for images.

text_size.name: Text size
text_size.description: Choose a preferred size; long text may be scaled down to fit. Ignored for images.

bold.name: Bold text
bold.description: Use a heavier typeface for text labels. Ignored for images.

tape_width_mm.name: PT tape width
tape_width_mm.description: Select the TZe width loaded in a PT-E550W.

label_size.name: QL DK media
label_size.description: Select the DK roll or die-cut media loaded in a QL-710W.
